# Novo Nordisk Showcases CagriSema Trial Gains and Wegovy Food Noise Reductions Ahead of FDA Decision

**Novo Nordisk** [(NYSE:NVO)](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NVO) presented trial and real-world data at ObesityWeek 2026 showing strong weight loss for investigational CagriSema and reduced food noise among Wegovy users.

**Read Also: [Novo Nordisk Scores EU Win For Hemophilia Drug, Advances Sickle Cell Treatment Toward Approval](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/biotech/26/11/63257974/novo-nordisk-scores-eu-win-for-hemophilia-drug-advances-sickle-cell-treatment-toward-approval)**

## CagriSema Delivers Weight Loss Across Lower Doses

On Saturday, Novo Nordisk [unveiled](https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=920561) primary Phase 3 REDEFINE 9 results in Washington, D.C., alongside simultaneous publication in *The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology*.

The trial tested CagriSema, a fixed-dose combination of cagrilintide and semaglutide, at doses below its 2.4 mg / 2.4 mg maximum.

Assuming full adherence, adults taking the 1.7 mg / 1.7 mg and 1.0 mg / 1.0 mg doses achieved 20.7% and 21.0% average [weight loss](https://www.benzinga.com/topic/weight-loss) at week 68, versus 2.0% for placebo. They also cut waist circumference by 17.2 cm and 17.5 cm, respectively, compared with 3.6 cm for placebo.

Under the treatment regimen estimand, those doses produced 19.4% and 18.6% weight loss versus 4.6% for placebo.

## Early Responders and Quality-of-Life Gains

On Sunday, the company [shared](https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=920645) two post hoc analyses from the Phase 3 REDEFINE 1 trial of CagriSema 2.4 mg / 2.4 mg. About 67.8% of treated participants lost at least 5% of their body weight by week 8 and reached 25.4% mean weight loss at week 68, versus [17.8% for delayed responders](https://www.benzinga.com/general/health-care).

At week 68, 73.1% reported meaningful physical function gains and 69.0% reported psychosocial improvements, topping placebo rates of 49.1% and 42.1%.

Novo Nordisk filed a New Drug Application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in December 2025 for CagriSema 2.4 mg / 2.4 mg and expects a decision in the fourth quarter of 2026.

U.S. regulators have not approved CagriSema, and trials have not established its safety and efficacy.

## Wegovy Reduces Food Noise in Real-World Studies

Novo Nordisk also [presented](https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=920563) Saturday findings from the retrospective SIGNAL and OCTANE studies using de-identified Ro telehealth data and a seven-item questionnaire tracking intrusive food thoughts.

In SIGNAL, 26,213 adults initiating [semaglutide injections](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/earnings/26/11/62863179/novo-nordisk-raises-2026-outlook-as-wegovy-pill-shines) cut food-noise scores from a 2.72 baseline by 0.42 points at one month and 0.72 points at six months.

In OCTANE, adults starting oral semaglutide lowered food-noise scores by roughly 25% over three months, while 86.4% reported at least one improvement, including better-fitting clothing (67.5%) and [healthier eating (51.6%)](https://www.benzinga.com/general/biotech).

**NVO Price Action:** Novo Nordisk shares were up 0.73% at \$41.94 at the time of publication Monday, according to [Benzinga Pro data](https://www.benzinga.com/pro/register-3).
